The raw_customers table has 230 rows for 200 distinct customers. 30 rows are historical (is_current=False, valid_from 2023-06-01) and 200 are current (valid_from 2025-01-01). The join in gold_region_daily uses silver_customers with no is_current filter, so each transaction for a customer with a history row is counted twice. That accounts for the extra 686 rows (5286 − 4600).

The fix is to keep only current rows in silver_customers. Each customer has exactly one current row (200 current rows, 200 distinct customers, and every customer has at least one row), so the dimension becomes unique. The transaction dates are all January 2026, which is after both valid_from dates. The current row is therefore the right one for all of them, and no point-in-time lookup is needed.

Whether current region is the intended attribution is a small ambiguity. Still, the silver_customers table is meant to be the current dimension, so filtering on is_current is the natural fix.
